decided: Amends the two-collector decision after review round 1: adapters/httpbatch is deleted as well. The first shard's named default kept it, reasoned as 'not a collection backend' — review established its only consumers were the five deleted HTTP-push exporters and nothing in the tree imports it.
why: An orphan module with a doc claiming it serves three deleted exporters is exactly the standing docs-accuracy lie the house-clean exists to remove; keeping plumbing for nothing contradicts the item's simplicity intent.
cost_if_wrong: A future HTTP-push exporter re-adds it with a git revert; until then zero maintenance surface.
alternatives: Keep with a reworded doc — rejected: rewording a doc for a module with zero importers preserves dead weight to make a sentence true
scope: Deletes adapters/httpbatch, its go.work entry, and test/loggolden's inert replace. Supersedes the first shard's keep-httpbatch default.
